name: Onan
overview: Onan, a son of Judah, is known in Scripture for his refusal to fulfill the duty of raising offspring for his deceased brother, as commanded by Judah (Genesis 38:8-9). He deliberately spilled his seed on the ground to avoid providing an heir, an act that displeased the Lord and resulted in his death (Genesis 38:10). Both Onan and his brother Er died in the land of Canaan, highlighting the serious consequences of disobedience to God's commands regarding family responsibility (Genesis 46:12; Numbers 26:19).
